description: This file defines the implementation of the Shutdown class for the webAudio task in the Rialto server project. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute method that logs actions and stops the worker thread of the web audio player.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the shutdown process of the web audio player, including stopping its worker thread.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Shutdown object with a reference to the web audio player.

methods.name: ~Shutdown
methods.description: Destructor that logs the shutdown completion.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the shutdown operation by stopping the worker thread of the web audio player.
